purpose: Compare coach-first C strategy with both unchanged previous C first deliveries per task; generate only two new D pages

authorization.user_scope: User authorized a local coach-first comparison; no online changes
authorization.limit_origin: Internal allocation fixed before the first freeze or call; not a user-specified monetary limit
authorization.limit_reason: Two fixed new first deliveries; independent internal allowance confirmed by root before freeze; preserve conservative relay reservations and do not expand after freeze
authorization.pricing: Reuse EX13 peak-price estimate and conservative reservation. Preserve missing-usage and failed-stream reservations; these are not an actual provider bill

previous_activity.relationship: Settled older activities retained separately; their combined total is added once to the new D activity and never charged against its fresh8 CNY cap

model.limits: Same main-author request settings and production per-request limits as prior C
model.served_model: Record returned model on every call; alias alone does not prove a fixed backend version

presentation_plan.scope: D independently invokes the unchanged C coach prompt/configuration before the first author sampling; author_proposal is explicitly null

limits.retry_policy: No pilot, no replacement samples, no retry of failed samples. Ordinary generation/intervention failure and per-run32-call exhaustion remain and next fixed sample proceeds. Monetary exhaustion, provider stream failure, missing usage or timeout stop the batch and leave unstarted positions explicit. External interruption is retained; no automatic resume or rerun.

D.label: Coach before author framework; selected full materials supplied
D.behavior: Explicit presentation admission invokes the coach before the main author starts. Same coach prompt/configuration and selected full-material supply as prior C, with author_proposal=null. Preserve an independently generated plan; do not replay old C plans.

comparison.estimand: Directional page-quality comparison of two new coach-first D outputs with both prior C outputs for each same task; baseline pages are unchanged and not regenerated
comparison.shared: Byte-identical task inputs, same author model/prompt/tools and per-run limits, same coach prompt/configuration, method catalog/materials, frozen Reader and fresh per-run history
comparison.changed: Coach timing before first author sampling, necessary explicit presentation_planning_requested=true admission, and author_proposal=null instead of an earlier author framework/focus
comparison.limitations: One new D versus two prior C outputs per task, noncontemporaneous runs and independently generated coach plans; cannot claim an isolated causal timing effect or learner-outcome improvement
comparison.failure_inclusion: Retain both fixed positions regardless of intervention coverage or quality; no coverage gate and no replacement generation

catalog.source: ../common-source/skills/presentation/methods/catalog.json; revision6 and11 method versions including chart-reveal@3; source-freeze.json records byte identity with prior verified catalog
catalog.candidate_status: Local experiment only; online and formally adopted catalog remain unchanged
catalog.selection: No method IDs or method_refs seeded in heldout author prompts. Coach may choose no method

isolation.author_input: Byte-identical copies of original heldout inputs; no old outputs, evaluator notes or review findings in author context
isolation.task_exposure: Only root and experiment custodian may inspect author tasks and oracle before generation; implementation agents do not receive them
isolation.history: Fresh native memory, history and temp directory per run; no base-version or prior-conversation import
isolation.coach: Same coach prompt/configuration with separate user request, actual source evidence, prior guidance and catalog; author_proposal is explicit null. SE8 sets presentation_planning_requested=true in request context, recorded from PreparedAgentChat in native input.json; no extra author instruction or rewritten user text.
isolation.reader: ../render-source/manifest.json; exact seven-file Reader reused from prior C
isolation.teaching_review: Same observing fixture; no active Tutor review loop

outcomes.primary: First successful delivery in the initial user turn, allowing ordinary self-preview and patch. Review page correctness and communicative usefulness against task and independent oracle
outcomes.linkage: Separate selected methods, autonomous tool reads, host-forced actual material text, complete-file coverage, declared method_refs and visible application. None is a substitute for page quality
outcomes.coach_record: Record purpose=tutor_presentation_plan input/output, explicit-null author_proposal, and ordinal before the first main-author chat request. Record actual coach handoff and selected-material definitions in first-author request separately from later/pre-write supply. Later prepare must not create an additional coach request; violations stay visible without excluding quality samples.
outcomes.forced_supply_record: Each selected catalog file is a resident-agent.presentation.method-source.{method_id}.{revision}.{file}@method-source.v1 InstructionModule. Actual ordered system sampling_guidance.v1 definition contains presentation_method_source.v1 plus JSON {method_id,revision,file,characters,text}. Record exact character coverage and request order separately from tool reads. observations.supplied_files confirms successful runtime sampling per asset but has no request ordinal; a manifest alone never counts. Preserve response errors, absent receipts and partial intervention without excluding quality samples
outcomes.also_archive: First write and first delivery, public native/provider I/O, actual coach input/output, all method-read/forced-supply evidence, failures/incomplete outcomes, usage, conservative cost and unstarted IDs
outcomes.evaluation: Read full rendered page and exercise actual UI. Mechanism topic needs shared-node identity and path accumulation; derivation topic needs complete connected derivation and degenerate-case reasoning. Do not impose universal short-video or first-screen-chart criteria
outcomes.decision: Small directional timing-strategy comparison using two new D and four prior C pages; coverage and order diagnostics do not prove or gate quality.
